messages:
Mina Rao: hey all 44b starting today as a product designer. quick on-boarding checklist: need Figma access, product roadmap Notion, and where research insights live. whos the best point for each?

Diego Alvarez: welcome Mina!! :tada: I handle the Figma invites for design. drop your work email here or DM me and Ill add you to the Product Design team and enable the "Redwood UI" library.

Mina Rao: thanks Diego  DM sent (mina@redwood.com). question: are designers full editors by default? i prefer to avoid accidental overwrites.

Diego Alvarez: designers get editor by default, but we use file versioning and branches in the team library. If you want comment-only on specific files, you can request that per-file.

Rae (design-ops): hi Mina! Notion access is managed by design-ops. Please submit the access form: https://notion.redwood.com/access-requests (choose "product > design") and Ill grant product-viewer within an hour.

devex-bot: Tip: you can run `/request-access Figma` to auto-create a ticket for design-ops.

Priya (Research): welcome! Research notes: recordings are on the Research Drive; syntheses and highlight reels are in Notion under Research > Artifacts. If you tell me which area youre focusing on (signup, onboarding, billing), I can drop a short reading pack.

Mina Rao: onboarding + signup would be great. also, where do we keep research annotation conventions for Figma files?

Priya (Research): for Figma annotations we use comments with the prefix "Research:" and the tag of the study (e.g., Research: Signup-Intl). We also maintain a Research Annotations page in Notion with examples. Ill add you to that page once Rae grants access.

Diego Alvarez: FYI: after I add you, open a design file and enable the team library via `Assets > Team Libraries`. If components look off, run `Plugins > Redwood Tokens` to sync styles.

Mina Rao: got the Figma invite. another quick one: roadmap link?

Rae (design-ops): roadmap is here: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap. youll see read-only unless the PM for an initiative adds you. If you want to collaborate on the onboarding initiative, tag @Diego or @Rae and well request edit rights.

Priya (Research): mini onboarding checklist for first week: 1) skim 3 recent synths (i added links in your DM), 2) join Wed research sync (10am PT), 3) shadow a usability session (ill invite you).

Mina Rao: awesome thanks! last: who can add me to the weekly design crits calendar?

Diego Alvarez: added you to Design Crits (Fri 11am PT). If you want to present in week 1, ping me and Ill slot you.

Mina Rao: amazing, appreciate the fast help. ill ping here if any perms block me. :)
